progression.narrative: The performance opens on Db3 and dwells most on Db in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:17.2) introduces B, centred on Db. Phrase 6 (0:56.5) introduces Ds, centred on Db. The line peaks at Db5 (547.7 Hz) at 0:32.7. It closes on Ds4, not the tonic (Db5 → B4 → B4 → Db5 → Db4 → Ds4).
